# Assured

Assured is a Insurance Agencies and Brokerages company. Assured is a trusted cyber insurance broker that helps businesses protect against cyber risks. They provide exceptional planning, solid policies, and security progression to protect businesses before, during, and after a cyber incident. Assured employs 85 people (+51.8% YoY, +29 people), founded in 2022. Headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with offices in Cambridgeshire and Saint Neots. Its workforce is distributed across United Kingdom, Netherlands, Canada, and Switzerland.

## About

At Assured, we curate and execute cyber insurance programmes that assure corporates and institutions that their insurance will deliver when they need it most.

Without the distractions of other commercial insurance lines, Assured channels all of its effort and passion into cyber. Assured wants to change the way executives engage with cyber insurance. Our value goes above and beyond a standard insurance policy. We understand the importance of buying a policy that actually pays out, but we believe cyber insurance should go further. It must inspire confidence, empower executives and ultimately, deliver assurance.
